source_text: ἐμελέτα κατὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν ἀπόνοιαν, τοῖς τῶν Αἰγυπτίων πρωτοτόκοις ἐφίει τὸν ὀλοθρευτὴν, καὶ τὸν ἐν μιᾷ νυκτὶ κατεψηφίζετο θάνατον, ὁ πάντων ἔχων τὴν ἐξουσίαν. Προενόει δὲ ὅπως αἱ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἀγέλαι μὴ ὑπενεχθεῖεν τῷ κακῷ, καὶ ὡς ἀπωτάτω γένοιντο τῆς τοῦ διαφθείροντος χειρὸς, εἴτ' οὖν ὀργῆς. Ἀλλ' οὐκ ἦν ἑτέρως τοῦτο πρᾶξαί τισι, πλὴν ὅτι διὰ Χριστοῦ, ὅς ἐστι ζωὴ καὶ ζωοποιὸς, ἅτε δὴ ζωῆς τῆς κατὰ φύσιν ἐκπεφυκὼς, τοῦ Πατρός. Προανετύπου τοίνυν ὁ νόμος τὸ ἐπ' αὐτῷ μυστήριον, ὧδέ τε φησίν· «Εἶπε δὲ Κύριος πρὸς Μωσῆν καὶ Ἀαρὼν ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου, λέγων· Ὁ μὴν οὗτος ὑμῖν ἀρχὴ μηνῶν, πρῶτός ἐστιν ὑμῖν ἐν τοῖς μησὶ τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ. Λάλησον πρὸς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, λέγων· Τῇ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τούτου λαβέτωσαν ἕκαστος πρόβατον κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν, ἕκαστος πρόβατον κατ' οἰκίαν. Ἐὰν δὲ ὀλιγοστοὶ ὦσιν ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ, ὥστε μὴ εἶναι ἱκανοὺς εἰς πρόβατον, συλλήψεται μεθ' ἑαυτοῦ τὸν γείτονα τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ, κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ψυχῶν, ἕκαστος τὸ ἀρκοῦν αὐτῷ συναριθμήσεται εἰς πρόβατον. Πρόβατον τέλειον, ἄρσεν, ἐνιαύσιον ἔσται ὑμῖν. Ἀπὸ τῶν ἀμνῶν καὶ τῶν ἐρίφων λήψεσθε, καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν διατετηρημένον ἕως τῆς τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτης τοῦ μηνὸς τούτου, καὶ σφάξουσιν αὐτὸ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος συναγωγῆς υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς ἐσπέραν. Καὶ λήψονται ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος, καὶ θήσουσιν ἐπὶ τῶν δύο σταθμῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν φλιὰν, ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις ἐν οἷς ἐὰν φάγωσιν αὐτὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς. Καὶ φάγονται τὰ κρέα τῇ νυκτὶ ταύτῃ ὀπτὰ πυρὶ, καὶ ἄζυμα ἐπὶ πικρίδων ἔδονται. Οὐκ ἔδεσθε ἀπ' αὐτῶν ὠμὸν, οὐδὲ ἑψημένον ἐν ὕδατι, ἀλλ' ἢ ὀπτὰ πυρί· κεφαλὴν σὺν τοῖς ποσὶ καὶ τοῖς ἐνδοσθίοις. Οὐκ ἀπολείψεται ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἕως πρωΐ· καὶ ὀστοῦν οὐ συντρίψετε ἀπ' αὐτοῦ. Τὰ δὲ καταλειπόμενα ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἕως πρωῒ, ἐν πυρὶ κατακαύσετε. Οὕτω δὲ φάγεσθε αὐτό· αἱ ὀσφύες ὑμῶν περιεζωσμέναι, καὶ τὰ ὑποδήματα ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς ποσὶν ὑμῶν, καὶ αἱ βακτηρίαι ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν ὑμῶν, καὶ ἔδεσθε αὐτὸ μετὰ σπουδῆς, Πάσχα ἐστὶ Κυρίῳ. Καὶ διελεύσομαι ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ταύτῃ, καὶ πατάξω πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως κτήνους, καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς θεοῖς τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ποιήσω τὴν ἐκδίκησιν, ἐγὼ Κύριος. Καὶ ἔσται τὸ αἷμα ὑμῖν ἐν σημείῳ ἐπὶ τῶν οἰκιῶν ὑμῶν, ἐν αἷς ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐκεῖ, καὶ ὄψομαι τὸ αἷμα, καὶ σκεπάσω ὑμᾶς, καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ἐν ὑμῖν πληγὴ τοῦ ἐκτριβῆναι, ὅταν παίω ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἔσται ἡμέρα ὑμῖν αὕτη μνημόσυνον, καὶ ἑορτάσετε αὐτὴν ἑορτὴν Κυρίῳ εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν, νόμιμον αἰώνιον ἑορτάσετε αὐτήν. Ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἄζυμα ἔδεσθε, ἀπὸ δὲ τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς πρώτης, ἀφανιεῖτε ζύμην ἐκ τῶν οἰκιῶν ὑμῶν. Πᾶς ὃς ἂν φάγῃ ζύμην, ἐξολοθρευθήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἐξ Ἰσραὴλ, ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς πρώτης, ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς ἑβδόμης. Καὶ ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ πρώτη, κληθήσεται ἁγία, καὶ ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ ἑβδόμη, κλητὴ ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν· πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε ἐν αὐταῖς, πλὴν ὅσα ποιηθήσεται πάσῃ ψυχῇ, τοῦτο μόνον ποιηθήσεται ὑμῖν.» Βούλει δὴ οὖν λεπτῶς καὶ ἐπιδρομάδην
pass_a_gloss: (… unbroken) he practiced the madness against God, he let loose the destroyer upon the firstborn of the Egyptians, and voted the death in one night, the one having the authority of all. But he provided beforehand that the herds of the Jews should not be brought under the evil, and that they should be as far as possible from the hand of the one destroying, or rather (his) wrath. But it was not (possible) to do this for any otherwise, except through Christ, who is life and life-making, inasmuch as he has been begotten of the life by nature, the Father. The law then prefigured the mystery about him, and says thus: 'And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt saying: this month (is) for you beginning of months, it is first for you among the months of the year. Speak to all the congregation of the sons of Israel saying: on the tenth of this month let them take each a sheep according to houses of families, each a sheep according to household. And if they are very few in the household, so as not to be sufficient for a sheep, he will take along with himself the neighbor near him, according to number of souls, each will be counted in for the sheep (according to) what is sufficient for him. A perfect sheep, male, one year old, it will be for you. From the lambs and the kids you will take, and it will be kept for you until the fourteenth of this month, and all the multitude of the congregation of the sons of Israel will slaughter it toward evening. And they will take from the blood and will put it on the two doorposts and upon the lintel, in the houses in which they eat them. And they will eat the meats in this night roasted by fire, and unleavened (bread) upon bitter herbs they will eat. You will not eat from them raw nor boiled in water, but only roasted by fire; head with the feet and the inward parts. It will not be left from it until morning, and a bone you will not break from it. And the things left from it until morning you will burn up in fire. And thus you will eat it: your loins girded about, and your sandals on your feet, and the staffs in your hands, and you will eat it with haste; it is a Passover to the Lord. And I will go through in the land of Egypt in this night, and will strike every firstborn in the land of Egypt from man to beast, and on all the gods of the Egyptians I will do the vengeance, I the Lord. And the blood will be for you as a sign upon the houses in which you are there, and I will see the blood and will shelter you, and there will not be among you a blow of destruction whenever I strike in the land of Egypt. And this day will be for you a memorial, and you will feast it a feast to the Lord for all your generations, an eternal ordinance you will feast it. Seven days you will eat unleavened (bread), and from the first day you will make leaven vanish from your houses. Everyone who eats leaven, that soul will be utterly destroyed from Israel, from the first day until the seventh day. And the first day will be called holy, and the seventh day will be a called-holy (convocation) for you; every work of service you will not do in them, except the things that will be done for every soul, this alone will be done for you.' Do you wish then, finely and in passing (… going through each thing, let us say the fitting things) (continues).
pass_b_english: Cyril: …madness he kept up against God, the one who holds authority over all let loose the destroyer on the firstborn of the Egyptians, and passed sentence of death on them in a single night. But he took care beforehand that the flocks of the Jews should not fall under the evil, and should be as far as possible from the hand, or rather the wrath, of the destroyer. Yet this could be done for anyone in no other way than through Christ, who is life and gives life, since he was begotten of the one who is life by nature, the Father. So the law sketched in advance the mystery concerning him, and speaks thus:

‘The Lord said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt: This month shall be for you the beginning of months; it is the first for you among the months of the year. Speak to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying: On the tenth of this month let each man take a sheep by their fathers' houses, each man a sheep for a household. And if there are too few in the household to be enough for a sheep, he shall take with him his neighbor who is near him, according to the number of souls; each shall be counted toward the sheep according to what is enough for him. Your sheep shall be perfect, male, a year old; you shall take it from the lambs and from the kids. And it shall be kept by you until the fourteenth day of this month, and the whole multitude of the congregation of the sons of Israel shall slaughter it toward evening. And they shall take some of the blood and put it on the two doorposts and on the lintel, in the houses in which they eat them. And they shall eat the meat that night, roasted with fire, and they shall eat unleavened bread with bitter herbs. You shall not eat any of it raw, nor boiled in water, but only roasted with fire, the head with the feet and the inward parts. None of it shall be left until morning, and you shall not break a bone of it; and what is left of it until morning you shall burn with fire. And this is how you shall eat it: your loins girded, your sandals on your feet, and your staffs in your hands; and you shall eat it in haste. It is the Lord's Passover. And I will pass through the land of Egypt on this night, and I will strike every firstborn in the land of Egypt, from man to beast, and on all the gods of the Egyptians I will execute judgment: I am the Lord. And the blood shall be for you a sign on the houses in which you are; and I will see the blood and shelter you, and there shall be no plague among you to destroy you when I strike in the land of Egypt. And this day shall be a memorial for you, and you shall keep it as a feast to the Lord throughout all your generations; you shall keep it as an everlasting ordinance. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and from the first day you shall remove leaven from your houses. Whoever eats leaven, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from Israel, from the first day until the seventh day. And the first day shall be called holy, and the seventh day shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall do no work of service on them, except what must be done for every soul; this alone shall be done by you’ (Exodus 12:1–16).
Would you like us, then, closely and yet briefly…

choices.term: τῆς κατὰ φύσιν ... ζωῆς ... τοῦ Πατρός
choices.english: begotten of the one who is life by nature, the Father
choices.why: τοῦ Πατρός stands in apposition to ζωῆς; the Father is the life by nature.
The old English stopped at verse 4; Cyril quotes verses 1–16 and comments on them in §§4–9.

choices.english: closely and yet briefly… (§4: going through each point)
choices.why: The sentence runs across the column break; the English stops where the Greek of §3 stops.
